About

About 2S Business Support Service

2S Business Support Service builds AI assistants, workflow automation, CRM systems, and human-in-the-loop support for small and growing service businesses.

Our approach starts from a simple principle: automate what machines do well — repetitive, well-defined, high-volume work — and keep people involved where judgment, exceptions, and quality matter. We'd rather build a smaller number of workflows that actually hold up in daily use than a long feature list that looks impressive and doesn't get used.

We started by validating this approach deeply in roofing, and have since expanded the same underlying systems into dental and HVAC — with more industries planned as each vertical proves out.

What we build with

  • AI assistants

How we work

After you request a consultation, we start with a conversation about what's actually taking up your team's time — not a sales pitch. From there:

  1. We review what you've described and identify which parts are realistic to automate.
  2. You get a plain-language recommendation, including a written proposal before any build work starts.
  3. Any third-party software, API, or telephony costs required for your automation are explained upfront in that proposal — never added after the fact.
  4. We build, test, and hand off the workflow, with human escalation points defined before launch.
